summary: Per-character request of ecl::sound::PointAndClickSoundSystem: UpdateSoundRequestComponents (Toolkit EoCClient.dll, stride 0x48) copies the system's ls::Optional<PointAndClickSoundSystem::ReactionToPlay> into it, or resets it. Born live when the host started sneaking (with SoundFinishedPlayingEvent, IsSneaking).

fields.name: SwitchGroup
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xDFC710 ecl::sound::PointAndClickSoundSystem::ConfigureSoundSwitches appends pairs (FixedString +0, FixedString +4) whose first member is always one constant per pair (the combat-state group, the approval group) and whose second is chosen by condition; EoCClient.dll+0xDFCC50 matches +0 against those group constants and +4 against their values: a Wwise switch group and its state.

fields.name: SwitchState
fields.evidence: Second FixedString of the pair built in ConfigureSoundSwitches (EoCClient.dll+0xDFC710): the value chosen for the group at +0 (combat / sneaking / normal; negative / neutral / positive / romantic from the approval rating type), matched by EoCClient.dll+0xDFCC50.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: UpdateSoundRequestComponents copies ReactionToPlay byte +9 here; reset to 0. Live 0/1.

fields.name: ReactionName
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xDFF7F0 ecl::sound::PointAndClickSoundSystem::UpdateSoundRequestComponents copies ReactionToPlay +0x10 here (STDString::operator=); ConfigureSoundEvent (EoCClient.dll+0xDFC5F0) fills ReactionToPlay +0x10 from EoCClient.dll+0xDFCFF0, which builds 'BGClickReaction' + '_Action' or '_ReptAction' + '_Attack', '_HealTarget', '_MoveTo' ... from the action. Live strings of 0x1D/0x26 characters.

fields.name: field_24
fields.evidence: Copied from ReactionToPlay +0x2C; reset to the global 'Unassigned' value. Live 0x1 / 0xFFFF0000.

fields.name: HasSwitchUpdates
fields.evidence: Has-value byte of the optional at +0x30 (cleared before destroying it, copied from ReactionToPlay +0x30). Live 0/1.

fields.name: SwitchUpdates
fields.evidence: Optional value: DynamicArray<ecl::sound::SoundSwitchUpdate> copied by FUN_180dfc0a0 and destroyed by FUN_180dfee40. Live: heap pointer, capacity 1, size 0/1.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD3BAE0 ecl::GameAnalyticsSystem::RecordPointAndClickSoundEvent (called from ProcessPointAndClickEvents with this component, stride 0x48) passes byte +0x40 to ecl::sound::ConvertToString(EPointAndClickActionType); UpdateSoundRequestComponents sets it from ReactionToPlay +8 through EoCClient.dll+0xDFCC50 and resets it to 0x14.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD3BAE0 RecordPointAndClickSoundEvent records byte +0x41 under the analytics key 'state' as 0 normal, 1 combat, 2 sneaking; EoCClient.dll+0xDFCC50 sets it from the state of the switch group ConfigureSoundSwitches sets to its combat value when the character is a combat participant and to its sneak value when sneaking.

fields.name: Approval
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xD3BAE0 RecordPointAndClickSoundEvent records byte +0x42 under the analytics key 'approval' as 1 negative, 2 neutral, 3 positive, 4 romantic; EoCClient.dll+0xDFCC50 sets it from the approval switch that ConfigureSoundSwitches (EoCClient.dll+0xDFC710) picks from eoc::approval::GetApprovalRatingType when CanSetApprovalSwitches holds.
